Place on the door tile (101,98) of inn_1 (house_01_5x5 / house_medium, door cell (2,4)) with origin (0.5,1) at the tile bottom-centre, then draw it offset_y_px = -196 (196 px up). Canvas y 0..128 then covers house y 372..500: hooks on the eave beam (house y ~460), board house y 464..492, door frame starts at y ~500, door opening at 516. Render rule: draw after (above) inn_1 and use inn_1's base y (the door tile south edge) for depth sorting, not the offset draw position, so the house never hides it and the player walking through the door passes in front of it.
